core_identity.summary: Bant is the green-white-blue shard of Alara. Official design commentary identifies Bant as a white-centered green-white-blue faction. Bant is a civilization of martial honor, structured hierarchy, and noble order, built around a sigil system that rewards knights for great deeds. Exalted is Bant's primary mechanic in the Shards of Alara block, representing the cultural practice of rallying collective support behind a single champion who attacks alone.
confirmed_claims: Bant is the GWU shard of Alara. [SRC-001, SRC-004]
Bant is white-centered within the green-white-blue arc. [SRC-036 — directly read; MRW Bant Week article confirms 'white is the central color to Bant']
Alara was split into five shards, each with only three colors of mana. [SRC-001, SRC-004]
The five shards of Alara are: Bant (GWU), Esper (WUB), Grixis (UBR), Jund (BRG), Naya (RGW). [SRC-004]
Exalted is the Bant-associated mechanic from Shards of Alara block. [SRC-003]
Exalted rules text: 'Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, that creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.' [SRC-003, SRC-011]
Rafiq of the Many is a legendary human knight from Shards of Alara and Bant's most iconic figure. [SRC-007]
Bant is composed of five nations. [SRC-007 — inferred from flavor text]
Valeron and Akrasa are confirmed Bant nations. [SRC-005, SRC-016]
Knight-General Rafiq is Rafiq's confirmed title in the official story 'A Man of Parts.' [SRC-005]
The Conflux reunited Alara's five shards. [SRC-004]

great_tension.summary: Bant's central tension is the relationship between idealized collective order and the reality of a world that was fractured, then violently reunited. Official design commentary (MRW Bant Week article, SRC-036) states white's view: 'The absence of Black and Red has allowed us to focus on the utopia I've talked about before.' The Conflux exposed Bant to those absent influences. Bant's culture channels collective honor behind a single champion (expressed mechanically through exalted).
great_tension.interpretation_warning: This is interpretive synthesis from design commentary and faction mechanics context. It is not directly stated in a single reviewed in-world story source. Do not present as confirmed canon.

mechanics.associated_set: Shards of Alara block (ALA, CON, ARB); also Magic 2013 (M13)
mechanics.rules_summary: Exalted is a triggered ability. Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, that creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn. Each separate exalted trigger applies independently, allowing cumulative bonuses from multiple exalted sources.
mechanics.design_or_flavor_connection: Official design commentary connects exalted to Bant's Shards of Alara identity. The mechanic represents Bant's cultural practice of channeling collective honor and support behind a single champion who rides to battle alone.
mechanics.notes: Exalted keyword rules text confirmed by card printings and official mechanics article. Rafiq of the Many does not carry the exalted keyword; he has a related but distinct 'attacks alone' triggered ability giving +1/+1 for each Aura and Equipment attached to the attacker. Exalted appears primarily on Bant-watermarked cards in ALA and CON. Alara Reborn uses no watermarks. Magic 2013's Sublime Archangel extends the mechanic outside the original block without Bant-specific lore connection.
